data.reply: Hi, thanks for reaching out and sorry for the trouble. Currently, CloudDesk focuses on file sharing and project collaboration. While we don't have built-in video conferencing, you can easily share meeting links within comments. For a direct integration with specific video conferencing platforms, please submit your request and preferred tools at roadmap.cloudesk.com/integrations/video-conferencing to help us assess demand for future partnerships. [T-2488] Let us know if that does not resolve it.
